description: A describe-level retry (`jest.retryTimes(2, { entireDescribe: true })`) whose test fails on its first attempt, while a timer set at module scope makes a rejection nobody handles during that attempt. jest-circus 30.5.2 raises `processErrorGeneration` as soon as an unowned rejection is reported during a describe attempt (`eventHandler.ts`, `case 'error'`), so the block is not retried: the test fails with its first error (one invocation), and the rejection is the file's at `run_finish` (`testExecError`). Kept: every stderr line that is not a stack frame, a code frame, a test list line, a time, a count line or runner noise. One Jest worker. A black-box run, read by `provino`'s `jest-uncaught.test.ts`.
